about: One input per row of molang's LanguageMessage table (1-49; #6 is the kept message), the golden input of the addon's diagnostic mapping. Rows are compiled on the client side at `version` with the default query set and `ops` (all, or no_assignments); each message is the vanilla text, its E.. id and the addon severity: error for a rejecting message, warning for a kept one (#6, and a root-only message below the root). Inputs come from molang tests/parse_vectors.json (commit ffa4a42) where it has one, else from molang tests/diagnostics.rs (also every row whose vectors fail to link, #43 and #47, since the vectors leave the link messages #48 and #49 out).
